leakage_risk_vectors_identified.risk_description: Identical normalized message text appearing across train, val, and test splits.
leakage_risk_vectors_identified.mitigation_protocol: Exact text deduplication on MD5/SHA-256 normalized hash before partition splitting.

leakage_risk_vectors_identified.risk_description: Messages differing only by recipient names, reference IDs, tracking codes, or minor punctuation (e.g. `Ref #1001` vs `Ref #1002`).
leakage_risk_vectors_identified.mitigation_protocol: MinHash LSH and 3-gram Jaccard similarity clustering (threshold >= 0.85). All samples in a cluster assigned to the same partition or deduplicated.

leakage_risk_vectors_identified.risk_description: Mass spam campaigns where a single template body is populated with dynamic variables (e.g., Nigerian 419 inheritance letters sharing identical paragraph structures).
leakage_risk_vectors_identified.mitigation_protocol: Template fingerprinting using structural n-gram and sentence skeleton hashing. Entire campaign clusters isolated into a single split.

leakage_risk_vectors_identified.risk_description: Embedded phishing URLs or domain names in training text that also appear in test text, allowing the NLP model to memorize malicious domains rather than textual scam semantics.
leakage_risk_vectors_identified.mitigation_protocol: 1. URL Tokenization: Replace raw URLs in NLP text with generic `<URL>` tokens, evaluating URL structure separately via the URL Phishing Detector. 2. Cross-partition domain exclusion: Ensure no domain appearing in train URLs is present in test message URLs.

leakage_risk_vectors_identified.risk_description: Single-source imbalance where Source A provides 100% of phishing and Source B provides 100% of legitimate emails, causing the model to learn source-specific formatting/headers rather than scam intent.
leakage_risk_vectors_identified.mitigation_protocol: Multi-source balanced blending and cross-source validation (training on Source A+B, testing on held-out Source C).

leakage_risk_vectors_identified.risk_description: Evaluating historical models on past data without verifying performance on newer emerging scam vectors (e.g. crypto, Telegram, UPI).
leakage_risk_vectors_identified.mitigation_protocol: Establish a distinct chronological out-of-distribution (OOD) stress benchmark containing modern lure vectors.

partition_strategy_specification.partition_method: Stratified Cluster-Aware Partitioning (GroupKFold / Cluster splitting on Near-Duplicate clusters)
partition_strategy_specification.frozen_test_invariance: Test set generated once, SHA-256 checksummed, and made immutable during model experimentation.
